limitations: This is a research data-readiness screen. It is not a clinical tool and makes no claim of clinical validity, regulatory compliance, or production readiness.
Identifier detection is heuristic. A pass does not guarantee that no personal information is present.
Leakage detection checks one feature at a time and can miss leakage spread across several features.
Thresholds (events per parameter, minimum subgroup size, missingness) are configurable defaults, not clinical standards.
Subgroup coverage uses minimum counts and does not compare against a reference population.

spec.question_text: Is this dataset suitable for a research study of which baseline factors (stage, receptor status, tumor size, age at diagnosis) are associated with disease worsening within 2 years in breast cancer patients diagnosed since 2012, including whether a model performs consistently across race and ethnicity?

report.text:
**Verdict: Blocked** for the question: "Is this dataset suitable for a research study of which baseline factors (stage, receptor status, tumor size, age at diagnosis) are associated with disease worsening within 2 years in breast cancer patients diagnosed since 2012, including whether a model performs consistently across race and ethnicity?"

Why:
- [EVT-001] (Blocked) Only 12 records in the smaller outcome class; too few to develop or evaluate a model.
- [CMP-004] (Conditional) Predictor 'tumor_size' is missing for 26% of the cohort.
- [SUB-002] (Conditional) Some subgroups are too small to evaluate model behavior reliably: race=black (n=12), race=asian (n=10), race=other (n=5), race=hawaiian (n=2), race=native (n=1), ethnicity=hispanic (n=30).

To make this dataset ready for this question:
- [EVT-001] Use a larger cohort or a more common outcome.
- [CMP-004] Plan and document an imputation strategy, or drop the predictor.
- [SUB-002] Report subgroup performance with uncertainty, or obtain more data for these groups.
